chunks: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fadhal from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadah from Ammar al-Sabati who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who prays the obligatory prayer, then finds a group of people praying in congregation; is it permissible for him to repeat the prayer with them? He said, 'Yes, and it is better.' I said, 'And if he does not do so?' He said, 'There is no harm in it.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to repeat an obligatory prayer in congregation after having already prayed it individually?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that re-praying an obligatory prayer in congregation after having already performed it individually is a recommended act (mustahabb) rather than a mandatory one. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the spiritual merit of communal worship (fada'il al-jama'ah) while maintaining flexibility for the individual, reflecting the balance between communal obligation and personal ease in Shia fiqh.
